text:
## International Data Transfers  
**Current Transfers:** UK + EU only  
**Non-EEA Transfers (If Future):**
- Require Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC)
- Adequacy decision from UK government
- Supplementary safeguards assessed  
---
name: Chunk 26/36

raw_entities.name: International Data Transfers Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing the transfer of personal data across international borders, currently limited to UK and EU jurisdictions. Establishes requirements for non-EEA transfers including Standard Contractual Clauses, adequacy decisions, and supplementary safeguards assessment.

raw_entities.name: Restriction of Current Transfers to UK and EU
raw_entities.description: Provision restricting current international data transfers to UK and EU jurisdictions only, establishing the baseline scope of permissible transfer destinations.

raw_entities.name: Standard Contractual Clauses Requirement for Non-EEA Transfers
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that any future data transfers to non-EEA jurisdictions must be supported by Standard Contractual Clauses as a legal mechanism for data protection.

raw_entities.name: UK Government Adequacy Decision Requirement for Non-EEA Transfers
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that non-EEA data transfers must be supported by an adequacy decision from the UK government confirming equivalent data protection standards in the destination jurisdiction.

raw_entities.name: Supplementary Safeguards Assessment for Non-EEA Transfers
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to assess and implement supplementary safeguards for any non-EEA data transfers to ensure adequate protection beyond the primary transfer mechanism.

raw_entities.name: Standard Contractual Clauses
raw_entities.description: International standard contractual framework approved for lawful transfer of personal data from the EU/UK to non-adequate third countries, referenced as a required mechanism for non-EEA transfers.

raw_entities.name: UK Government Data Adequacy Decision Framework
raw_entities.description: UK regulatory framework establishing adequacy decisions for non-EEA jurisdictions, determining whether destination countries provide equivalent data protection standards.

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized International Data Transfer
raw_entities.description: Risk of personal data being transferred to jurisdictions without adequate legal safeguards or contractual protections, potentially exposing data subjects to inadequate privacy standards.

raw_entities.name: Standard Contractual Clauses Implementation
raw_entities.description: Operational control requiring the implementation and maintenance of Standard Contractual Clauses as a contractual safeguard for all non-EEA data transfers.

raw_entities.name: Supplementary Safeguards Assessment Process
raw_entities.description: Operational control requiring systematic assessment and documentation of supplementary safeguards for each non-EEA data transfer to ensure compliance with data protection standards.
